description: This file defines classes and functions related to capturing, tracing, and manipulating dataframes within the PyTorch data pipeline framework. It includes classes for capturing data operations, mock objects, and data pipeline transformations, specifically for dataframes.

classes.name: Capture
classes.description: Base class for capturing data operations and expressions within the data pipeline.

classes.name: CaptureControl
classes.description: Class managing the global capture enable/disable state.

classes.name: DataFrameTracedOps
classes.description: Class for tracing operations on dataframes within a data pipeline.

classes.name: CaptureF
classes.description: Extended class for capturing function calls with context.

classes.name: CaptureA
classes.description: Class for capturing attribute access within the data pipeline.

classes.name: CaptureLikeMock
classes.description: Mock object for capturing attribute access during testing.

classes.name: CaptureVariableAssign
classes.description: Represents assignment of a captured variable.

classes.name: CaptureVariable
classes.description: Represents a captured variable with unique naming.

classes.name: CaptureGetItem
classes.description: Captures item access (e.g., indexing) on data objects.

classes.name: CaptureSetItem
classes.description: Captures item assignment on data objects.

classes.name: CaptureDataFrameWithDataPipeOps
classes.description: Subclass for capturing dataframes with data pipeline operations.

classes.name: DataFrameTracer
classes.description: Data pipeline class for tracing dataframe operations, decorated with functional_datapipe.

methods.name: apply_ops_2
methods.description: Applies stored operations to a dataframe.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Property to get columns after applying operations.

methods.name: set_shuffle_settings
methods.description: Stub method for setting shuffle settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for various classes, initializing internal state.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the captured expression or operation.
